strategy.thesis: Privately run 'startup resource management company' combining co-working/private offices, maker space and a registered incubation program; supports local and international founders (including via the Taiwan Employment Gold Card) and connects them to an advisor network, accelerators and VCs rather than taking equity.

investment.raw: no equity taken (resource/workspace incubation, not an equity investor)

program.location: Taipei (FutureWard Central: B1F., No. 343, Changchun Rd., Songshan Dist.; FutureWard Civic: 10F., No. 206, Sec. 3, Civic Blvd., Da'an Dist.)
program.eligibility: Early-stage local and international startups, makers and entrepreneurs

track_record.portfolio_count: Manages one of the largest segments of Taipei startups (1,400 ping / 48,000 sq ft of co-working across FutureWard Central and Taiwan Tech Arena)

application.how_to_apply: Apply for membership / incubation via futureward.com or email admin@futureward.com

summary.en: FutureWard is a private Taipei co-working and incubation operator that calls itself a 'startup resource management company.' It opened its first space (FutureWard Tatung) in May 2014, became a registered incubator in May 2017, ran the Taiwan Tech Arena co-working project from Feb 2018, joined the Employment Gold Card project in Oct 2020 and registered as an international startup incubator in May 2021. It manages over 48,000 sq ft (1,400 ping) of co-working space and supports founders with offices, maker space and an advisor network rather than equity.
summary.local: FutureWard(未來產房)為台北民間共享辦公與育成業者,自稱「新創資源管理公司」。2014 年 5 月開設首座空間(FutureWard Tatung),2017 年 5 月成為登記育成中心,2018 年 2 月承接 Taiwan Tech Arena 共享空間專案,2020 年 10 月加入就業金卡計畫,2021 年 5 月登記為國際新創育成。管理超過 48,000 平方英尺(約 1,400 坪)共享空間,以辦公室、創客空間與業師網絡支持創業者,而非收取股權。

name.local: t.Hub 內科創新育成基地

strategy.thesis: Large vertical incubation base in the Neihu Technology Park (NTP 2.0) co-developed with the Taipei City Government and operated with ITRI's professional assistance; provides co-working and private offices, a maker space, three-stage guidance (creativity, enterprise upgrade, business expansion), founder–procurement matchmaking and investment matchmaking with angels.

investment.raw: no equity (incubation base; subsidized space and services)

program.location: Taipei (Building B, No. 335, Ruiguang Rd., Neihu Dist. — Neihu Technology Park core)
perks: Co-working and private offices (3F-10F, Building B)
Founders Market Meetup with procurement managers
program.eligibility: Startups and innovation teams seeking space and incubation in NTP

track_record.portfolio_count: 62 teams at opening (Nov 2020); 7,865 ping over 10 floors

summary.en: t.Hub (內科創新育成基地) is a vertical incubation base in Taipei's Neihu Technology Park, opened on 27 November 2020 (trial operations from 25 August 2020) as part of the city's NTP 2.0 project and described as 'the largest incubation center in Taiwan.' It spans 7,865 ping across floors 1-10 of Building B and had recruited 62 teams (77% occupancy) at opening. It offers co-working, private offices, a maker space and matchmaking events, with professional operation assistance from ITRI; it does not take equity.
summary.local: t.Hub(內科創新育成基地)為台北內湖科技園區的垂直創業育成基地,2020 年 11 月 27 日正式開幕(2020 年 8 月 25 日試營運),屬臺北市「NTP 2.0」計畫,號稱「全台最大的育成中心」。位於 B 棟 1 到 10 樓、面積達 7,865 坪,開幕時已招募 62 組團隊、進駐率 77%。提供共享/獨立辦公空間、創客空間與媒合活動,由工研院協助專業營運,不收取股權。

strategy.thesis: Privately operated innovation hub run by consulting firm Plan b in the former Zhongshan Soccer Stadium; mixes long-term offices for cross-industry companies with co-working (in partnership with 混hun) and Fablab Taipei maker space, and serves as an NDC-selected base for entrepreneur visa and foreign-talent programs.

program.location: Taipei (No. 1, Yumen St., Zhongshan Dist. — west wing of the former Zhongshan Soccer Stadium, Yuanshan)
perks: Co-working with 混hun (hot desks, dedicated desks, glass cubicles)
program.eligibility: Startups, freelancers, makers and cross-industry companies

track_record.portfolio_count: 2,233 sq m facility (incl. 300 sq m lobby)

application.how_to_apply: Apply for office/co-working space via cit.tw or email cit@theplanb.cc

summary.en: CIT (Center for Innovation Taipei / 台北創新中心) is a privately operated innovation hub run by the consulting firm Plan b in the west wing of the former Zhongshan Soccer Stadium in Taipei's Yuanshan area. The 2,233 sq m facility (incl. a 300 sq m lobby) combines long-term offices (40-105 sq m), co-working in partnership with 混hun, and Fablab Taipei maker space. Since 2016 it has been an NDC-selected base whose 'CIT residency certification' lets teams apply for the Entrepreneur Visa and foreign-talent programs.
summary.local: CIT(台北創新中心)為顧問公司 Plan b 在台北圓山舊中山足球場西側營運的民間創新基地。場域面積 2,233 平方公尺(含 300 平方公尺大廳),結合長期辦公室(40-105 平方公尺)、與「混hun」合作的共同工作空間,以及 Fablab Taipei 創客空間。自 2016 年起為國發會合作基地,持「CIT 進駐認證」之團隊可申請創業家簽證與外籍人才相關計畫。

aka: 遠邦國際品牌 CrossBond Brands

strategy.thesis: Government-certified private incubator focused on ASEAN and Indian founders who want to build businesses in Taiwan (and Taiwanese teams expanding into Southeast Asia); qualified to sponsor the Taiwan Entrepreneur Visa and supports founders with visas, company setup, consulting, co-working space and the largest ASEAN/India network in Taiwan.

investment.raw: no equity (incubation, visa and consulting services)

program.eligibility: ASEAN/India entrepreneurs starting up in Taiwan; need meet only 1 of 6 Entrepreneur Visa criteria

application.how_to_apply: Apply via crossbond.tw/en/incubator (visa application assisted from start to submission)

summary.en: CrossBond (遠邦國際品牌顧問 / CrossBond Brand Consultant Co.) is a government-certified private incubator founded in 2017 that focuses on ASEAN and Indian founders building businesses in Taiwan. As a certified incubator it is qualified to sponsor the Taiwan Entrepreneur Visa (applicants need meet only 1 of 6 criteria) and supports founders with company setup, consulting, co-working space, mentors and a multilingual entrepreneur's manual; it does not take equity.
summary.local: CrossBond(遠邦國際品牌顧問)為 2017 年成立的政府認證民間育成機構,專注協助東協(ASEAN)與印度創業者來台創業。作為認證育成機構,可協助申請台灣創業家簽證(六項條件符合其一即可),並提供公司設立、顧問諮詢、共同工作空間、業師與多語版創業手冊等支持,不收取股權。

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's largest incubator for ASEAN and Indian talent, helping Southeast Asian and Indian professionals start businesses in Taiwan and Taiwanese teams expand into Southeast Asia; provides hands-on guidance on visas, company registration, accounting, tax, IP, fundraising, office space and government/OEM-ODM connections.

program.eligibility: ASEAN/Indian entrepreneurs in Taiwan and Taiwanese startups expanding to Southeast Asia

application.how_to_apply: Contact via STARTBOARD's channels (Facebook/LinkedIn) for incubation and visa support

summary.en: STARTBOARD is a private Taipei incubator founded around 2017 and led by Uniform Lin, described as 'Taiwan's largest incubator for ASEAN and Indian talent.' It helps Southeast Asian and Indian professionals (Taiwan hosts about 60,000 such students) start businesses in Taiwan and helps Taiwanese teams go into Southeast Asia, offering hands-on support with visas, company registration, accounting/tax, IP, fundraising, office space and OEM/ODM connections. Notable clients include Innoviz (Vietnam) and AImazing (Singapore/Malaysia).
summary.local: STARTBOARD 為約 2017 年成立、由 Uniform Lin 帶領的台北民間育成機構,被稱為「台灣最大的東協與印度人才育成機構」。協助東南亞與印度專業人士(台灣約有 6 萬名相關留學生)在台創業,也協助台灣團隊進入東南亞,提供簽證、公司登記、會計稅務、智財、募資、辦公空間與 OEM/ODM 媒合等實務支持。知名輔導對象包括 Innoviz(越南)、AImazing(星馬)。

strategy.thesis: Cross-border, cross-industry platform (since 2017) connecting world-class founders, executives and capital with Taiwan's supply-chain-driven innovation ecosystem; runs a 30-day Asia immersion program and sector platforms/labs/summits, and selectively participates in early-stage opportunities via Anchor Venture Partners rather than operating as a traditional VC or accelerator.

investment.raw: selective early-stage capital participation (via Anchor Venture Partners); immersion program is not equity-based

perks: Network across 15+ countries (YC, 500 Startups, Microsoft, Uber, Intel alumni)
program.eligibility: Global founders, executives and investors exploring Asia / Taiwan opportunities

track_record.portfolio_count: 100+ corporates engaged; 1,000+ industry leaders through summits/forums (10+ years)

application.how_to_apply: Apply to the immersion program / engage via anchor-venture.com

summary.en: Anchor Taiwan (now Anchor Global / Anchor Venture Partners) is a private cross-border platform founded in 2017 by Elisa Chiu, a former investment banker who managed over US$1B in pan-Asia assets. It brings world-class founders and executives (from YC, 500 Startups, Microsoft, Uber, Intel and 15+ countries) into Taiwan's supply-chain innovation ecosystem via a 30-day Asia immersion program plus sector platforms, an industry lab and an annual summit, and selectively invests at the early stage through Anchor Venture Partners. It is recognized as an incubator/accelerator by Taiwan's competent authority.
summary.local: Anchor Taiwan(現為 Anchor Global / Anchor Venture Partners)為 Elisa Chiu(邱懷萱)於 2017 年創辦的民間跨境平台;她曾任職頂尖投行與避險基金,管理逾 10 億美元亞太資產。透過 30 天亞洲沉浸式計畫,以及產業平台、Anchor Industry Lab 與年度峰會,將來自 YC、500 Startups、Microsoft、Uber、Intel 等 15+ 國的頂尖創業者與高管引入台灣供應鏈創新生態,並透過 Anchor Venture Partners 選擇性參與早期投資。獲台灣主管機關認列為加速器/育成機構。
